submittedPrompt: 绘制清晰中文网页局部状态矩阵，平面白底浅灰面、蓝色普通主动作、红色错误、细线小圆角，字体紧凑易读。每行独立以留白细线分开，只画真实局部，不画外部主人导航、浏览器、审查编号或注释。六个紧凑独立行，不画六个完整弹窗。1 分享忙态局部：分享权限“仅查看”、链接有效期“7 天”、未勾选“允许下载图形原件”均灰色禁用；只读公开链接https://example.invalid/s/example，旁边“复制链接”仍可用；底部“重置链接”“取消分享”“保存分享设置”“完成”都禁用，保存分享设置转圈。2 失败保留表单：红色“暂时无法保存分享设置，请重试。”，分享权限仍仅查看，有效期自定义时间，自定义到期时间2027/01/01 12:00，允许下载图形原件勾选，控件均可用。3 只画真实弹窗页头“分享笔记”和可用关闭X、底部灰色禁用“完成”，不能加忙态蒙层或禁用X。4 公开链接只读框https://example.invalid/s/example，复制按钮勾选图标“已复制”。5 同链接框和可用“复制链接”，红色“复制失败，请选中公开链接手动复制。”。6 同链接框和普通可用复制链接，没有已复制或错误。公开链接是可选择只读输入，不能当密码掩码；不加重置/撤销确认窗、自动关闭或其它按钮。

sourceContracts.title: Share request busy and form-error state

entry.trigger: Load/submit sharing settings or validation/network failure

permissionRules: Authenticated owner browser session; /api owner hook returns 401 if absent and 503 during maintenance. Mutations require configured Origin and CSRF token (apps/server/app.ts:141). No administrator/member role split is implemented for these owner surfaces.
Full ShareDialog owner form is owned by this workspace inventory. Settings inventory owns ShareManagement listing/entry only; public inventory owns anonymous reader/editor.

status.editSupported disables the edit option; server rejects edit for primary diagrams, invalid diagram documents, large/long-line Markdown. Browser state does not imply a new public editor permission.

Parent Workspace manageShare/shareAction captures noteId+viewEpoch; note switch closes form and ignores stale response; duplicate mutations are blocked by shareBusy. Shared status updates after successful result.

Busy disables permission/expiry/source controls and action/Done buttons. ShareDialog does not explicitly disable NModal mask/Escape/close-x dismissal while busy; copy-link remains callable. Do not invent a busy dismissal lock.

actions.label: 关闭表单
actions.guard: No explicit busy dismissal lock in ShareDialog; Done button itself disabled

importantStates: shareBusy action spinner and disabled form inputs/buttons
Alert chooses error then validation then copyError
Initial status request failure uses workspace global error and does not open new form

responsive.behavior: Shared .dialog-card width min(550px,100vw-28px), max90dvh scroll. Share settings two columns desktop, one column<=540px; actions wrap and buttons flex on narrow screens. Actual320/390/1440 layout unverified.

sourceContracts.designReason: Existing user-visible surface requires baseline-aligned hierarchy, controls, feedback and responsive treatment without adding behavior.
notes: Source inventory only; no runtime behavior asserted.

concerns: Static raster is not proof of executed actions, owner/recipient permissions, focus/keyboard, guard enforcement, canvas topology or responsive fit.
